snippet.title: Death Machine - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Death Machine now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741830/Death_Machine/

Conquer the mechanical citadel in Death Machine - a metroidvania, with a roguelite item system. Gather items to gain strength, navigate the perilous machine world, leverage the aid of ancient demons, and seek out dangerous denizens to defeat before the forces of the machine close in on you. A game made by yours truly.
